name: Search with results
layerWhy: It does one whole job, finding things, with every result and feedback state, from primitives only.
promise: Type, and see what matches, how many, and what to do when nothing does.
expectation: A search field and its results under it.
evidence: Waiting shows the results' shape; then a count and each result with the match marked; none offers a way out; a failure offers Try Again.
behaviour: Waits 250 ms after typing; a late answer never replaces a newer one.
context: Docs, records, a product's whole content.
relationships: Built from a search field, list items, skeletons, an empty state and an alert.
accessibility: A search landmark; the count and states are announced.
dont: A search that only works on Enter with no feedback.
